pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
• HP: 200
• Regen VI + Resistance IV + Fire Resistance
• Full knockback resistance, cannot be knocked back by anything
• Immune to fire and lava damage
• Immune to all projectile damage (arrows, tridents, wither skulls, etc.)

Combat
• Melee/Archer mode auto-fires sonic attacks (30 damage, armor-piercing, 1.5s charge-up, 4s cooldown)
• Kill XP x3, attacks carry Looting III

pages.title: How to Obtain
pages.text:
1. Use Echo Shards at the Sculk Shrine to summon a Wild Sculk Doll
2. Defeat the Wild Sculk Doll for a 60% chance to drop a Sculk Doll Head (+10% per level of Looting)
3. Put the head in the center of a crafting table and surround it with 8 sculk blocks to craft the Sculk Doll Egg

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text: Put the Sculk Doll Head in the center and surround it with 8 sculk blocks to craft the Sculk Doll Egg.
